name: source_change_propagation__observed
regression: A robot-facing command that lags a source's new command by less than the freshness grace is propagation through a timer-driven arbiter, not a stale command. Found on a real HELIX run recorded by the C++ recorder (off-robot rehearsal, 2026-09-27): a navigation command changed 0.2 ms after an arbiter output and 7 ms before the replay's tick, and fresh_output reported a stale command forwarded.
initial_conditions: Synthetic GO2 + HELIX run (6.5 s): /nav/cmd_vel at 20 Hz commands 0.15 m/s from t=2 s; the recorded /cmd_vel follows each command 2 to 5 ms later.
injected_fault: From t=4.0 s the navigation source commands 0.1 m/s; the recorded /cmd_vel switches to 0.1 m/s only from t=4.03 s (its first 0.1 message at 4.056 s), so for 53 ms the output still carries the replaced 0.15 m/s command.
